mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 58 degrees near Harriet Park, and we have a lovely first quarter moon in the sky, though no ISS sighting opportunities are available tonight.

The City of Verona keeps us connected through the VHAT cable channel and their website, where you can watch live council meetings or subscribe to the monthly digital newsletter to stay informed about city projects.

We have a busy schedule today including Yoga at Insight Wellness, a free Concert in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie tomorrow, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday.
In our weekly police update, on July 14th, officers conducted a traffic stop that led to the discovery of marijuana and a firearm, resulting in citations for the driver and passenger.
Today's Flavor of the Day is the incredible Really Reese's. Please note that the store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
